title: Clone Graph
algorithm: DFS / BFS with Node Hash Map
oneLinerQuestion: Create a deep copy of a connected, undirected graph.
explanation: Traverse the graph with DFS. For each visited node, allocate a newly cloned node in memory and store the original-to-clone mapping in a hash map. Attach cloned neighbor edges on return to prevent infinite cycle recursion.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION cloneGraph(node):
    IF node IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL
    visited = EMPTY_HASH_MAP()
    FUNCTION dfs(n):
        IF n IN visited THEN RETURN visited[n]
        copy = NEW Node(n.val)
        visited[n] = copy
        FOR neighbor IN n.neighbors DO:
            APPEND dfs(neighbor) TO copy.neighbors
        END FOR
        RETURN copy
    END FUNCTION
    RETURN dfs(node)
END FUNCTION
